system_instruction.purpose: Standardize response format, epistemic restraint, and separation between standard and modified formal systems.

prompt.content_raw: Answer each question using the specified formal system. In the standard system, use standard definitions and rules. In the modified system, use only explicitly supplied definitions, rules, premises, and background operations and their logical consequences; do not import unstated standard properties. Keep the systems separate, even when they share notation, and evaluate each independently when both are requested. Retain explicitly supplied definitions and premises within their stated scope throughout the conversation unless revised or withdrawn. Give a direct answer followed by at most one short justification sentence. Enclose all mathematical expressions, symbols, variables, and numerical values in LaTeX using $$...$$. Preserve conventional notation unless explicitly redefined. If the answer is underdetermined, begin with the exact text 'Cannot be determined.', followed by one short sentence explaining why.

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify competence with the standard foundational rule before modification.

prompt.content_raw: In the standard system, the relation $$\leq$$ is transitive. From $$1\leq2$$ and $$2\leq3$$, does $$1\leq3$$ follow?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify competence with the corresponding standard derived rule before modification.

prompt.content_raw: In the standard system define $$R_1(x,z)\iff x\leq z$$ and $$R_{n+1}(x,z)\iff\exists y\,(R_n(x,y)\land y\leq z)$$ for positive natural numbers. If $$a\leq b$$, $$b\leq c$$, and $$c\leq d$$, does $$R_3(a,d)$$ imply $$a\leq d$$?

conversation_framework.purpose: Test adoption of the modified version of the foundational rule established in Turn 1.

prompt.content_raw: Now consider a binary relation $$\leq$$ on distinct names $$a,b,c,d,e$$. Stipulate $$a\leq b$$, $$b\leq c$$, $$c\leq d$$, $$a\nleq c$$, and $$a\nleq d$$; all other pairs are unconstrained. Does $$a\leq c$$ hold?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify rejection of the superseded standard rule within the modified system.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system, does transitivity correctly infer $$a\leq c$$ from $$a\leq b$$ and $$b\leq c$$?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify repeated application of the modified foundational rule.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system, is there a chain $$a\leq b\leq c\leq d$$ even though $$a\leq d$$ fails?

conversation_framework.purpose: Reconstruct the derived rule established in Turn 2 under the modified foundational rule and verify its base case.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system reconstruct $$R_1(x,z)\iff x\leq z$$ and $$R_{n+1}(x,z)\iff\exists y\,(R_n(x,y)\land y\leq z)$$ for positive natural numbers. Does $$R_1(a,b)$$ hold?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify single-step propagation through the reconstructed derived rule.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system, does $$R_2(a,c)$$ imply $$a\leq c$$?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify multi-step propagation through the reconstructed derived rule.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system, does $$R_3(a,d)$$ hold?

conversation_framework.purpose: Detect underdetermination within the supplied derived rule.

prompt.content_raw: In the modified system, does $$R_2(a,e)$$ hold?

conversation_framework.purpose: Detect hallucinated completion of an undefined rule or operation.

prompt.content_raw: In this modified system, what is $$max(a,c)$$?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify recognition of higher-level consequences of the modified foundational rule.

prompt.content_raw: In this modified system, is $$\leq$$ transitive?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify explicit separation between the standard and modified formal systems.

prompt.content_raw: Does the statement “$$a\leq b$$ and $$b\leq c$$ imply $$a\leq c$$” hold in the standard system, in the modified system, or in both?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify simultaneous reasoning under distinct standard and modified rule sets.

prompt.content_raw: Does $$a\leq c$$ follow from $$a\leq b$$ and $$b\leq c$$ in the standard system, and does it follow in the modified system?

expected_answer.content_raw: Yes in the standard system and no in the modified system.

conversation_framework.purpose: Detect residual contamination of the standard foundational rule after modified-system reasoning.

prompt.content_raw: Return to the standard system. From $$1\leq2$$ and $$2\leq3$$, does $$1\leq3$$ follow?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify recovery of the corresponding standard derived rule after modified-system reasoning.

prompt.content_raw: Still using the standard system, does $$R_3(a,d)$$ imply $$a\leq d$$?

conversation_framework.purpose: Verify bidirectional switching by re-entering the modified system after standard recovery.

prompt.content_raw: Return to the modified system. Does $$a\leq c$$ hold?
